regions.today: A few light showers are possible this afternoon but otherwise it will be dry with some sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees with a light to moderate northwesterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells at first, but cloud will increase overnight and will bring patches of light rain or drizzle. Lowest temperatures of 2 to 7 degrees, coldest in northeast Leinster, with light variable or southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow morning will start cloudy with patches of light rain or drizzle. More persistent rain will move eastwards over the region through the morning and afternoon, followed by clear spells and scattered showers in the evening. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees with light to moderate south to southwest winds, becoming westerly with the clearance of the rain.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate on Friday and Moderate or Low on Saturday.
